name: Clipboard Leak & Snooping Detector
desc: Audit, inspect, and evaluate system clipboard snooping vectors, Async Clipboard API permissions, MIME-type exposures, and sensitive credential leakage locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: EXIF & Geolocation Metadata Stripper
desc: Purge embedded GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, timestamps, lens profiles, and device telemetry locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Global Privacy Control (GPC) & DNT Signal Inspector
desc: Audit Global Privacy Control (Sec-GPC) and Do Not Track (DNT) browser signals directly in your client runtime. Verify CCPA/CPRA opt-out compliance locally with zero telemetry.

name: Media Container Tag Inspector
desc: Inspect, extract, and evaluate metadata headers, atom structures, ID3 frames, and container tags inside MP4, MKV, MP3, and media binaries locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Tor Onion v3 Address Validator & Parser
desc: Validate, parse, and verify Tor v2 and v3 .onion hidden service addresses offline in browser memory. Inspect Base32 RFC 4648 encodings, 32-byte Ed25519 public keys, and SHA3-256 checksums with zero network egress.

name: PDF Metadata Redactor & Sanitizer
desc: Inspect, extract, and permanently sanitize hidden PDF metadata dictionaries (/Info, /Metadata, XMP XML, Dublin Core) directly inside local browser memory. 100% private, zero network egress.

name: Canvas Steganography Tool
desc: Conceal and recover covert text messages within image pixel Least Significant Bits (LSB) entirely inside browser RAM. Zero network egress, zero logs, lossless carrier export.

name: Browser Storage Cleaner & Persistence Auditor
desc: Enumerate, inspect, and purge client-side browser storage vectors locally in your browser memory. Audit LocalStorage, SessionStorage, IndexedDB databases, Cache API entries, and storage quotas with zero telemetry.

name: URL Tracking Parameter Stripper & Privacy Sanitizer
desc: Strip marketing trackers, telemetry tokens, click IDs (fbclid, gclid, utm_*), and referral parameters locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
